measures.name: Margin I CUR DOM
measures.expression:
ROUND(
    [Net Sales CUR Dom] - [Curr Norm Cost CUR Dom],
    0
)

measures.name: Margin I (%) CUR DOM
measures.expression:
ROUND(
    [Margin I CUR DOM] / [Net Sales CUR Dom],
    2
)

measures.name: Spolka_z_kodu_Supplier_zakup
measures.expression:
VAR ManufacturerCode =
    SELECTEDVALUE(
        'Product Inventory'[PI Manufacturer Code]
    )
VAR PozycjaZ =
    SEARCH("Z-", ManufacturerCode, 1, 0)
VAR NetSales =
    [Net Sales CUR Dom]
RETURN
    IF(
        PozycjaZ > 0
            && NOT ISBLANK(NetSales),
        MID(
            ManufacturerCode,
            PozycjaZ + 2,
            LEN(ManufacturerCode)
        ),
        BLANK()
    )

measures.name: Czy_ta_sama_spolka
measures.expression:
VAR Spolka =
    [Spolka_z_kodu_Supplier_zakup]
VAR CompanyCode =
    SELECTEDVALUE('Company'[Company Code])
VAR NetSales =
    [Net Sales CUR Dom]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(NetSales) || NetSales = 0,
        BLANK(),
        IF(
            ISINSCOPE('Product Inventory'[PI Manufacturer Code]),
            CONTAINSSTRING(CompanyCode, Spolka),
            BLANK()
        )
    )

measures.name: Spolka_dostawca
measures.expression:
VAR Sprzedaz = [Net Sales CUR Dom]

VAR dostawca = [Spolka_z_kodu_Supplier_zakup]

VAR CompanyCode =
    SELECTEDVALUE('Company'[Company Code])

VAR CompanyCode_nadrzedny = 
    IF(
        ISBLANK([Net Sales CUR Dom]),
        BLANK(),
        CompanyCode
    )

VAR Czy_supplier_zawiera_sie_w_company =
    IF(
        NOT ISBLANK(dostawca)
        &&
        CONTAINSSTRING(CompanyCode_nadrzedny, dostawca),
        "Tak"
        )

VAR Wartosc_sprzedazy =
    IF (
        Czy_supplier_zawiera_sie_w_company = "Tak",
      Sprzedaz
    )

RETURN
round(Wartosc_sprzedazy, 0)

measures.name: Colaesce
measures.expression:
VAR ManufacturerCode =
    SELECTEDVALUE(
        'Product Inventory'[PI Manufacturer Code]
    )

RETURN
COALESCE([Spolka_z_kodu_Supplier_zakup], ManufacturerCode)
